title: Temperament Engineering: Designing Strategic Behavioural Diversity in Robot Swarms
summary: No two robots are truly identical: calibration, battery state, sensor drift and wear give every swarm a distribution of behaviour rather than a single point, usually treated as an imperfection to be minimised. In animal collectives the reverse holds: consistent individual differences in behaviour ('temperament') are shaped by natural selection and often decisive for group performance.
